sections.title: Part 3 · Reading — Anna's busy Saturday
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Last Saturday was a very busy day for Anna.

In the morning, she went to a clothes shop in the city centre. She wanted to return a jacket because it was too small. Fortunately, she had the receipt, so she exchanged it for a bigger size. The shop assistant also offered her a ten per cent discount on a new T-shirt.

At twelve o'clock, she met her friend Mai at a small restaurant across from the park. To start with, they had tomato soup. For the main course, Anna had grilled chicken, but Mai has a nut allergy, so she asked for a curry without nuts. When the bill came, they split it — it was fifteen pounds each.

In the afternoon, Anna went home and called customer service. There seemed to be a problem with her new fridge — it wasn't cold enough. The agent was very helpful. He booked a repair service for Wednesday morning, with no extra charge.

In the evening, Anna was exhausted, but she was happy. It was a busy day, but everything was fine in the end.

sections.title: Part 4 · Listening — A phone call: making an appointment
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: When was the first appointment?
Why does the caller want to change it?
What is the new time?
What does the caller ask the receptionist to do?
The caller's surname is ____.

script: Good morning, City Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
Hello. I'm calling about my appointment. It's on Thursday at ten, but I'm working on Thursday morning.
No problem. Could we move it to Friday? We have a time slot at half past two.
Sorry, could you say that again, please?
Of course. Friday at half past two.
Yes, Friday at two thirty works for me.
Great. Could you spell your surname, please?
Thank you. Let me confirm: Friday at two thirty, Ms Nguyen.
That's right. Thank you very much.

sections.title: Part 4 · Listening — A weekend story
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Where did Lan go last weekend?
Who did she go with?
What did she realise?
options: Her bag was in the taxi.
Her phone was at the hotel.
answers: Her bag was in the taxi.
items.show: Her bag was in the taxi.

items.prompt: They missed the train.
In the end, they got home at ____.

script: You'll never guess what happened last weekend!
I visited Hue with my cousin. At first, everything was fine. We visited a local market and ate street food.
Yes, we stayed in a small hotel. But on Sunday, while we were travelling to the station, I suddenly realised my bag was in the taxi!
Oh no! Did you get it back?
Yes. Fortunately, the driver called the hotel. Eventually, he brought it to the station.
That was lucky! Did you miss the train?
No, we didn't. In the end, we got home at nine. I was exhausted, but it was a memorable trip!
